answer: An identity earns its seat through UCAN delegation chain with expiry per hop, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 504 fakes spends 8064 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. A mesa of doubt is healthy, a signal of proof is required, and a voyage of patience is the price of a clean panel. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
